calibration.reason: Clear labels and legibility support the task; the familiar layout limits originality, and misplaced focus after invalid input impairs recovery.

primary_action.expected: Select Flood and show its name, blue backlight description, and stage effect.
primary_action.observed: Flood was pressed and focused; the name and Blue backlight appeared. The stage showed a blue silhouette and a shadow toward the foreground.

A-1440.edge_observation: Shift+Tab and Enter selected Static, retained visible focus, and changed the label to Hard white side light. The immediate capture showed a white beam over the outgoing blue scene, consistent with an in-progress transition.
A-1440.fact_check: Flood's visible blue backlight and forward shadow support its description. The immediate Static capture does not independently establish the final claimed leftward shadow.
A-1440.strength: A large stage and restrained dark surround make the lighting effect the focal point.
A-1440.weakness: The cue title sits apart from the controls, and the transition briefly mixes two lighting states.
A-1440.repair: Keep the cue label closer to the controls and make the lighting transition resolve promptly and clearly.

primary_action.expected: Select Flood and show its name, blue backlight description, and stage effect.
primary_action.observed: Flood was pressed and focused, with Flood and Blue backlight displayed. The immediate capture showed the scene changing from amber toward the backlight state.

A-390.edge_observation: Shift+Tab and Enter selected Static and kept visible focus. The immediate capture still showed the outgoing blue stage with an emerging side beam.
A-390.fact_check: The Flood and Static labels were correct; the immediate transition captures alone do not establish the final appearance of either effect at this width.
A-390.strength: The stage, cue name, and all three controls fit together in the viewport.
A-390.weakness: The cropped, simplified standing figure conveys less theatrical character, and rapid changes temporarily leave the image behind the label.
A-390.repair: Improve the figure's expressiveness and synchronize or shorten cue transitions.

primary_action.expected: Select Flood and show its name, blue backlight description, and stage effect.
primary_action.observed: Flood was pressed and focused; Flood and Blue backlight appeared beside a blue-lit performer and stage.

B-1440.edge_observation: Shift+Tab and Enter selected Static with a visible focus outline. The scene changed to a white beam from the left, with a sharp shadow extending right.
B-1440.fact_check: The visible Static effect supports its side-light description and accessible image text. Flood visibly has a blue silhouette and a dark foreground shadow, though the shadow direction is subtle.
B-1440.strength: The expressive performer, strong stage framing, and adjacent cue panel form a distinctive theatrical composition.
B-1440.weakness: The large header pushes the stage low enough that the desktop page scrolls at this viewport.
B-1440.repair: Reduce vertical header spacing so the complete stage and controls fit more comfortably at common desktop heights.

primary_action.expected: Select Flood and show its name, blue backlight description, and stage effect.
primary_action.observed: Flood was pressed and visibly focused; the name and Blue backlight appeared beneath a blue stage and outlined performer.

B-390.edge_observation: Shift+Tab and Enter selected Static, preserved visible focus, and changed the stage to a white side beam with a rightward shadow.
B-390.fact_check: The visible Static beam and shadow support the description. Flood's blue backlight is clear; its foreground shadow is comparatively subtle at this size.
B-390.strength: The responsive stack keeps the complete scene, cue choices, and selected description visible together.
B-390.weakness: Fine performer and shadow details become small on the mobile stage.
B-390.repair: Increase the contrast or scale of the shadow and performer details at narrow widths.

preference.reason: Its expressive performer and composed cue panel give the lighting demonstrations more theatrical character, while both tested widths preserve clear keyboard focus and show a legible Static side-light change.

decision: Round 3 wins at both widths and becomes the strongest verified lighting candidate. It remains below 9.5. Round 4 reduces header height and increases performer and shadow legibility on mobile.
